title: Custom T-Shirts for Parties and Events | VAM Deco
description: Custom t-shirts for bachelor and hen parties, birthdays and carnival. Quality DTF printing and embroidery in Ticino. Request a quote today.
h1: Custom T-Shirts for Parties and Events
estratto: Custom t-shirts for bachelor and hen parties, birthdays, carnival and private celebrations, with quality DTF printing and embroidery.

paragrafi: A custom t-shirt turns a party into a lasting memory. Whether it's a stag night, a birthday or carnival, a tailor-made design brings the group together and puts a smile on everyone's face. At VAM Deco we make them right here in Ticino using DTF printing and embroidery, for quality results that stand the test of time.

sezioni.heading: For every kind of party and event
paragrafi: We personalise t-shirts for any occasion, available in a range of colours, sizes and styles to match the mood of your celebration.
lista: Bachelor and hen parties: witty slogans and matching t-shirts to celebrate in style.
Birthdays and private parties: a name, an age, a slogan or a fun illustration.
Carnival and themed parties: coordinated group costumes and colourful graphics.
Special events: company parties, themed nights and get-togethers with friends.

sezioni.heading: DTF or embroidery: which one to choose
paragrafi: We work with two professional, long-lasting techniques. DTF printing (Direct to Film) is ideal for colourful graphics, fine details and complex logos, with vivid colours that hold up wash after wash. Embroidery adds a three-dimensional, elegant touch, perfect for a more refined, premium look.
Not sure which one suits you best? We'll recommend the ideal solution based on your design and the type of event.

sezioni.heading: Why choose us in Ticino
paragrafi: We use quality materials and advanced personalisation technology for crisp prints and finely detailed embroidery. Thanks to our experience customising sportswear and uniforms, we know how to create garments that are both durable and eye-catching.
We guide you from the design to the choice of technique, with tailored advice to make your event truly one of a kind.

faq.domanda: How much does a custom t-shirt cost?
faq.risposta: The price depends on the garment, the technique (DTF printing or embroidery) and the quantity. Get in touch with your idea and we'll put together a free, no-obligation quote for you.

faq.domanda: Can I order just one t-shirt?
faq.risposta: Yes. With DTF printing we can personalise even just a few pieces or a single t-shirt. For groups, such as a bachelor or hen party, we make matching t-shirts for all your guests.

faq.domanda: Is DTF printing or embroidery better?
faq.risposta: DTF printing is perfect for colourful, detail-rich graphics and is highly wash-resistant. Embroidery offers an elegant raised effect, ideal for a premium look. We'll help you choose based on your design.

faq.domanda: Do the prints hold up in the wash?
faq.risposta: Yes. DTF prints keep their colours vibrant wash after wash, while embroidery is hard-wearing and won't fade. Just follow the usual washing care and they'll last a long time.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to have them ready?
faq.risposta: Turnaround time depends on the quantity and the technique you choose. We recommend getting in touch a few days before your party, so we can agree together on the best delivery date.
